sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Kirienn A. Marrott.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Marrott worked for the American Fork Police Department from February 24, 2025 to June 15, 2025.

segments.text: transcript of Chief Cameron Paul’s September 16, 2026 interview with Daniel Sroka
records the following comments. Quotations below are from the final edited transcript.

contents.text_value: Discussing Marrott’s departure and field training, Chief Paul said:

segments.text: “She didn't actually make it out of FTO. We have a three-month FTO process—a field training process—and we had some recurring issues, so we let her go.”

contents.text_value: The final transcript identifies Marrott using the department roster and the sequence of officers discussed; the earlier drafts retain an uncertain rendering of her name.
